name: neals_funnel_noncentered
title: Neal's Funnel (Non-Centered Parameterization)
description: Neal's Funnel is a classic example of a hierarchical model that is difficult to sample from due to its geometry. This version uses a non-centered parameterization in which the lower-level variables are expressed as a transformation of standard normal variables. This reparameterization improves sampling efficiency by reducing the dependency between the upper and lower-level variables, making it easier for MCMC algorithms to explore the posterior distribution.
